bullets.text: Engineered a multi-agent NLP pipeline for structured extraction, converting raw reviews into structured JSON: review-type classification, per-topic sentiment, supporting evidence quotes, and staff-name linking, feeding reporting dashboards that contributed to a 20% lift in client retention.

Reduced inference costs using Python and a two-tier routing architecture: urgent single reviews route to the Gemini API for low-latency responses, while large batch jobs execute on a self-hosted Gemma 27B on company GPU hardware, keeping per-review costs down.

Improved model evaluation by raising subcategory recall from 0.78 to 0.96 (F1 0.98), measured on a 500-review golden set of hard cases, then locked in gains using CI/CD regression gates that re-run the dataset and fail builds if accuracy drops.

Adopted by account managers using the Python platform for client meeting prep: per-dealer breakdowns show exactly where dealerships struggle before entering client conversations, sharpening renewal and upsell strategy.
